info.name: Campground Booking — Ticket 08 Administrator Management
info.description: Run in order after seeding and provisioning an administrator. Supply ADMIN_EMAIL and secret ADMIN_PASSWORD locally. Creates two ordinary accounts and three bookings; deletes only this run’s bookings. All generated values are runtime-only.

exec: const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone: 'Asia/Bangkok', year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit' }).formatToParts(new Date());
const get = name => parts.find(p => p.type === name).value;
const start = new Date(get('year') + '-' + get('month') + '-' + get('day') + 'T00:00:00Z');
const day = n => new Date(start.getTime() + n * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
